How much the theme moves on its own. Ful: How much the theme moves on its own. Full: everything as designed (the default; already tuned to cost as little as it can). Balanced: fewer moving elements on and around items — no light following the cursor around store blocks and library panels, no shimmer on Play, no glares or light sweeps, 3D tilt covers lift instead, the Cinematic description stays still, the background light spots stand still; menus, hovers, page transitions, trailers, the store backgrounds (30 frames a second) and the glass notifications stay. Low: no Aika motion and no heavy effects at all — every look stays, but nothing the theme added moves (only Steam's own animations remain); the light spots are one still picture, no backdrop blur, no glass on notifications, no animated store backgrounds, no trailers playing behind the Cinematic page.
